data.title: A repeated single-value flag keeps its last value everywhere; only --label, --add-label, --remove-label, --rejected and --doc accumulate
data.why: decision add already treated a second --why or --task as a correction, and its tests pin that. Making every other flag follow the same rule, centrally in the argv plumbing, removes the class of bug (arrays reaching .trim() or the journal) instead of patching handlers one by one.
data.rejected: Reject any repeated single-value flag with invalid_argument: safer for an ambiguous intent, but contradicts the rule decision add already ships and its tests
